name: Few-shot Clinical Information Extraction Benchmark
description: A set of new datasets for benchmarking few-shot clinical information extraction tasks, including span identification, token-level sequence classification, and relation extraction, based on a manual re-annotation of the CASI dataset.
reputation: This benchmark is a specialized clinical NLP resource for few-shot information extraction and is mainly used in research on low-resource biomedical/clinical settings.
notes: Introduces new datasets based on re-annotation of CASI for few-shot clinical information extraction tasks.
